title: Generalized specific entropy on Wiener space with application to Martingale Optimal Transport
summary: Classical entropy regularization is poorly suited to continuous-time martingale transport, since relative entropy between diffusion laws typically forces their volatility characteristics to coincide. We introduce a specific-entropy framework based on Poisson jump approximations of continuous martingales. In the Gaussian-mark case, this yields explicit generalized specific entropy functionals on Wiener space, whose limiting costs depend not only on the limiting martingale laws but also on the microscopic approximation mechanism.
